tender.title: Clean Energy in the EU Enlargement Region – An Overview of Players, Strategies and Trends
tender.description:
The overall objective of this contract is to assess the preparedness of EU Enlargement countries (Ukraine, Moldova, Türkiye, Serbia, Bosnia and Herzegovina, Montenegro, Kosovo, Albania and North Macedonia) for the development and governance of clean energy solutions in line with EU strategic priorities such as the European Green Deal, Fit for 55 and REPowerEU.
Specific objectives include:
◦	Readiness assessment – Evaluate how well enlargement countries can seize opportunities and address challenges linked to clean energy deployment and decarbonisation. 
◦	Ecosystem analysis – Map the specificities of the clean energy industry ecosystem, covering companies, universities, research institutes and innovation hubs that are active in renewables, energy storage, smart grid and related technologies. 
◦	Policy and strategic review – Examine national policies, roadmaps and strategic initiatives that promote the clean energy transition and the integration of renewable resources into the energy system.
◦	Regulatory preparedness – Analyse the degree of alignment with EU regulatory frameworks (Renewable Energy Directive, EU Taxonomy, Carbon Border Adjustment Mechanism, etc.) and identify gaps. 
◦	Sectoral identification – Pinpoint the key sectors and application fields where clean energy technologies (i.e. solar, wind, hydro, biomass, hydrogen, storage, demand side management) have the greatest potential impact. 
◦	Recommendations – Deliver targeted, evidence-based recommendations to strengthen clean energy network development and promote regulatory convergence with the EU.
The contractor will pursue these objectives throughout the contract period, ensuring a consistent, systematic and evidence-based approach to producing the required analytical and policy relevant outputs.
tender.relevanceReason: Directly concerns clean energy development, decarbonisation, renewables, energy storage, smart grids, hydrogen and related regulatory alignment in the EU Enlargement region.
tender.triageBrief: EU-funded study assessing clean energy transition readiness, ecosystem mapping, and regulatory alignment in EU Enlargement countries, covering renewables, storage, smart grids, and hydrogen.

tender.title: Technical Assistance for Enhancement of the Institutional Capacity of TENMAK and Creation of an EU-Türkiye Stakeholders’ Platform to Foster the Dialogue on the Recovery of Secondary Critical Raw Materials for Energy Technologies
tender.description:
The main objective is to improve Türkiye’s capabilities in recovering critical raw materials
(CRM), particularly for renewable energy technologies with collaboration and dialogue with the
EU. The contractor will provide technical assistance to TENMAK covering services such as:
Situation analysis on CRM market in Türkiye, literature study via desk research and good practices
via study visits, requirement analysis for transition to circular economy in the CRM ecosystem in
Türkiye, Mid-Term Strategy and Roadmap for End-of-Life (EoL) Products Recovery Sector in
Türkiye, Strategy and Roadmap Workshop, Business Analysis for Development of Institutional
capacity of TENMAK/Rare Earth Elements Research Institute (NATEN), analysis and know-how
transfer on CRM recovery technologies, study for design of a pilot-scale EoL products recovery
facility for TENMAK, study for design of a Model EoL Products Recovery Facility for industry,
Introductory Meeting for Model Facility to sector stakeholders, Symposium on EoL products
recovery, trainings for TENMAK/NATEN on CRM recovery (technical trainings in Türkiye and
abroad, soft skills trainings), fellowship in EoL products recovery facilities, laboratories, research
institutes, etc. for metallurgical methods, permanent magnet recycling etc. in EU countries,
participation to international events on CRM recovery and creation of the Platform.
tender.relevanceReason: The title and description explicitly focus on recovery of critical raw materials for renewable energy technologies, including CRM recovery technologies, recycling, and a stakeholders’ platform for energy-related materials.
tender.triageBrief: EU-funded technical assistance tender for TENMAK (Türkiye) on recovery of secondary critical raw materials specifically for renewable energy technologies, including institutional capacity building, roadmaps, pilot facility design, and stakeholder platform creation.
